expected_function_roles.clamp_index: Clamps a table index to the inclusive range from zero to a supplied maximum.
expected_function_roles.lookup_2d: Clamps row and column indexes and returns a value from a three-by-four calibration table.
expected_function_roles.main: Runs embedded behavior self-tests and returns zero only when all pass.
